structured_extraction.professional_summary: Hands-on full-stack polyglot software engineer specialising in building trading systems with over 15 years experience in C++, Java, Python, Assembly, C, Rust, Ocaml and other languages. Experienced in individual contribution and engineering leadership, with diverse real-world project leadership across trading systems, compiler engineering, and machine learning infrastructure.

employment_history.title: Staff Software Engineer
employment_history.summary: Tech lead of software engineering teams working on Python developer tools, compiler engineering for Cinder and HHVM, and A/B testing infrastructure for Ads ML. Led improvements in Python parsing, performance optimizations reducing power usage, and experimental correctness in large scale distributed systems.

employment_history.title: Principal Engineer, Java compiler engineering
employment_history.summary: Led a small team optimizing the Java Virtual Machine (JVM) for performance improvements including partial escape analysis, register allocation, and compiler intrinsics. Provided internal consulting on JVM performance and held OpenJDK Author status.

employment_history.title: Tech lead / Founder
employment_history.summary: Founded and led development of Concurnas, an open source JVM programming language designed for concurrent, distributed, and parallel systems. Managed product development and business operations for nearly three years.

employment_history.title: FX automated trading strategist, FX & rates trading
employment_history.summary: Built and led a team to develop a client-facing FX option derivatives trading platform growing to $60M annual revenue. Developed algorithmic trading analytics and post-trade transaction cost analysis platforms. Mentored junior staff and contributed to sales training and client engagement.

employment_history.title: High frequency trading developer, Technology
employment_history.summary: Developed high frequency trading strategies and low latency market connectivity for foreign exchange. Managed a small team building a historical market data database.

projects.name: Pyre type checker improvements
projects.summary: Led a team improving Python type coverage, performance, and developer experience at Meta through enhancements to the Pyre type checker and developer tools.
responsibilities: Led a team of 3 engineers on Pyre type checker improvements.
Introduced error recovering parser for Python enabling efficient parsing of incomplete code.
Enabled syntactical and semantic analysis powering developer tools used by over 20,000 engineers.
deliverables: Upgraded internal Meta Python tooling to support Python 3.10 and simplified migration to 3.12.
business_outcomes: Unblocked over 20,000 engineers in Python development at Meta.

projects.name: Compiler work on Cinder and HHVM
projects.summary: Improved performance and power efficiency of Meta's Python and Hack runtimes through compiler optimizations and JIT compilation.
responsibilities: Reduced power utilization of Instagram web server fleet by 3% via AOT compilation of frequently invoked Python functions.
Introduced tiered JIT compilation similar to Java Hotspot for Cinder.
Applied escape analysis to reduce unnecessary object allocation in HHVM.
deliverables: AOT compilation for Python functions in Cinder.
business_outcomes: Reduced power consumption of Meta's web server fleets.

projects.name: Ads Machine Learning A/B testing infrastructure improvements
projects.summary: Led a team improving experimental correctness, latency, and resource efficiency of A/B testing infrastructure for machine learning models in Meta Ads.
responsibilities: Revamped experimental process to minimize computational resources for statistical significance.
Introduced dynamic resource allocation to reduce latency.
Implemented automated monitoring and enforcement of experimental best practices.
Revamped model release review process with senior ML researchers.
deliverables: Improved A/B testing workflows and resource allocation systems.
business_outcomes: Improved experimental outcomes reducing false negatives and positives.
Reduced latency and resource waste in ML model testing.

projects.name: Java Virtual Machine optimizations
projects.summary: Led JVM performance optimizations including partial escape analysis, register allocation improvements, and compiler intrinsics to improve memory usage, code performance, and startup times.
responsibilities: Implemented partial escape analysis and experimented with faster register allocation.
Provided internal consulting on JVM garbage collection tuning.
Implemented compiler intrinsics and backports for Java functionality.
deliverables: Performance improvements in JVM C2 server component.
Backports of Java features to earlier versions.
business_outcomes: Improved JVM memory usage by 10%, code performance by 15%, and startup times by 20%.

projects.name: Concurnas programming language development
projects.summary: Founded and led development of Concurnas, a JVM programming language designed for reliable, scalable, high-performance concurrent, distributed, and parallel systems.
responsibilities: Built Concurnas from scratch over three years.
Managed product development and business operations.
Promoted interoperability with Java and other JVM languages.
deliverables: Concurnas open source JVM programming language.
business_outcomes: Enabled organizations to leverage modern multi-core CPU and GPU hardware with safer, easier concurrent programming.

projects.name: FX option derivatives trading platform
projects.summary: Built and led a team to deliver a client-facing FX option derivatives trading platform growing to $60M annual recurring revenue.
responsibilities: Pitched and led development of the trading platform with a team of 16.
Managed global client franchise and cross-functional stakeholder interactions.
Trained salespeople and gathered client feedback.
deliverables: End-to-end FX option derivatives trading platform.
business_outcomes: Grew business from $0 to $60M annual revenue in three years.

projects.name: Algorithmic trading analytics platform
projects.summary: Developed analytics platform for post-trade transaction cost analysis and implemented new order types to control market impact.
responsibilities: Built analytics platform for post-trade transaction cost analysis.
Implemented 'percentage of volume' order type.
Trained salespeople and gathered client feedback.
business_outcomes: Improved transparency and execution performance for clients.

projects.name: High frequency trading strategies and market data database
projects.summary: Developed high frequency trading strategies and low latency market connectivity for FX, and managed a team building a historical market data database.
responsibilities: Implemented high frequency trading strategies in FX.
Developed low latency market connectivity.
Managed a team of 2 to build a historical market data database.
business_outcomes: Generated revenue through FX trading strategies.
